author: Binay Verma (analysis prepared by an AI assistant session; not an independent reviewer)
status: Descriptive re-analysis of ALREADY INSPECTED retrospective forecasts. Registered before these specific summaries were computed. No new forecasts, sources, cases, models, tuning or untouched-test claim. Results cannot change any frozen forecast or select any future arm.

A_cross_source_sign_agreement.purpose: Priority 1/2: does the typed-versus-pooled ordering and the event-information-versus-calendar ordering repeat across India (document_aligned) and NYC for the same model/representation/decision lead?
A_cross_source_sign_agreement.cells: 6 models x {day, window} x decision leads {1,7,14} = 36 typed-minus-pooled cells per source; plus typed-minus-calendar and pooled-minus-calendar per source.
A_cross_source_sign_agreement.rule: Use existing balanced MASE values unchanged. Report sign of each difference per source and count agreements. A difference with |value| < 0.005 MASE is ALSO reported as 'near-zero' (fixed threshold declared here, not tuned); agreement counts are reported both with and without this band.
A_cross_source_sign_agreement.interpretation_limit: Agreement counts are not independent trials (models, leads and representations share cases). No p-value is computed.

B_cluster_dependence_india.purpose: Priority 7: show the contrast at the level of real event clusters rather than rows.
B_cluster_dependence_india.reconstruction_check: First reconstruct balanced MASE from case-level predictions using the declared hierarchy (cases within state/year/family -> states within year -> years within family -> families equally). Must match metrics_balanced.csv to 1e-12 for every document_aligned model/arm/lead; otherwise stop and report failure.
B_cluster_dependence_india.clusters: family x year (10 groups; states averaged equally within each), year (2), family (5).
B_cluster_dependence_india.outputs: typed-minus-pooled per cluster for every model/representation/lead; count of clusters favouring pooling (>0), typed (<0); leave-one-family-out and leave-one-year-out balanced contrasts (min/max); unique target dates; state-date episodes.
B_cluster_dependence_india.inference: No bootstrap, t-test or p-value. Two event years make interval estimates for annual generalisation uninformative; years and families share states, weather and source vintage.

C_native_interval_clusters.purpose: Priority 7: dispersion of native 80% coverage across family-year clusters, reported with width and WIS and invalid/crossing counts.
C_native_interval_clusters.scope: Chronos-2 and TimesFM-3, document_aligned, arms calendar/day5/pooled_day5/window5/pooled_window5, all three leads.
C_native_interval_clusters.rule: Cluster coverage = mean over states of case-mean coverage80 within family-year. Rows with invalid80 retained and counted; if any case in a cluster has an undefined interval quantity, that cluster value is reported as undefined. No sorting, clipping or recalibration.

D_nyc_cells.purpose: Priority 7: report the 4 NYC family-mode cells as cells, without treating them as independent.
D_nyc_cells.rule: Copy typed-minus-pooled per series/family/decision lead from contrasts_series_year.csv; count signs.

not_done: No new outcome acquisition. No change to frozen prospective files.
